text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Vivlos and I decided to run the entire Triple Tiara route,
while keeping a close eye on her physical condition.
From that day on, various things began to happen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I'll devise a routine that reduces physical strain and allows for more efficient growth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since I hadn't pushed the naturally petite Vivlos with overly strenuous loads, creating a more efficient menu proved difficult.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, if that's the case,
feel free to use our menu for reference!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text: My girl struggled with physical issues too... so I'm sure this will help. Give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, Tracen Academy gathers all kinds of expertise.
With the help of various people, I created the best training routine for her current state.
choice_data_list: (And keep a close eye on Vivlos.)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainie!
Sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Geez, it was a total breeze!
I just trusted my gut â¡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~,
right?
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we head to the infirmary?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Okaaay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had the school nurse check on her regularly,
constantly aligning with her current state while adjusting menus
through a repeated process of trial and error.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day, spending our time like that,
with the Oka Sho just around the corner—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Train-chi!
Isn't it amazing~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Vivlos showed me was
her social media comments. There, it said—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Good luck on the Tiara route!"
"We're rooting for you!" "Get your revenge!"
"I'm a huge fan of Vivlos-chan♪"...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
There are so, so many
support messages coming in!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I've gained a ton of followers too, I feel like a real celebrity♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos's own fan base has grown significantly,
and her own motivation is soaring.
All that's left is...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yup, I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...No, let me take that back.
My stomach actually might hurt a little.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's not that bad.
You heard them say it hadn't gotten any worse
during yesterday's checkup, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While not a complete recovery, we've adjusted things enough to run races without issue. It's the result of you giving your best without overdoing it over these past two months.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Nuh-uh!
I'm the one who should be thanking you."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You've been thinking about me
so much, Trainie...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because they stayed by my side the whole time
to make sure I was truly alright.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...All the fans and Trainer
are cheering for me with everything they've got."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I want to properly live up to all of it.
choice_data_list: Make sure you don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her true dream lies in Dubai, first and foremost.
I understand her feelings toward the Triple Tiara, but
it's all for naught if it costs her the chance to aim for Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know.
But...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara
is my true dream now, too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
First is the Oka Sho!
We're gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first leg of the Tiara route,
the Oka Sho—is just around the corner.
